paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Avira. Rav Assi in his name (I did not find it). He said in Rabbi Shimon the pious’s name, Rosh Hashanah 35a; Rabbi Yitzchak’s name, Niddah 27a; Rav Ashi’s name, Berakhot 44a. Rava said, “When Rav Acha bar Avira sent”—I did not find it; his words have some error, see there.
